Believing he is about to receive ₹1 crore from the email lottery, Bhide daydreams about his newfound wealth—promising to contribute a massive ₹51,000 for the upcoming Ganeshotsav festival so no one else has to pay, while Madhavi fantasizes about flaunting heavy diamond jewelry and gold to the society ladies.
Step into Jethalal’s world with Gada Electronics! Manage the shop, tackle quirky customers, and experience nonstop TMKOC-style fun.
Are you ready for the challenge?
